🔥 Another winter, another hammer blow to family budgets.

📈 Ofgem's price cap rises 25.7% from 1 January.
💷 The typical dual-fuel bill goes from £1,723 to £2,166 a year, up £443.
📅 That's roughly £57 a month more from January to March, right when it's coldest.
🌍 The reason given: a wholesale price spike caused by the Middle East conflict.

A war thousands of miles away shouldn't be able to take £443 out of a Lancashire family's pocket. It can, because Britain has been left exposed by years of energy policy that put targets before security.

Reform UK: scrap the green levies on bills, back British oil and gas, and build reliable home-grown power.
